design: Board fullness asked directly in three shapes over the constant-length state, scored against the piece count. Separates "the complexity question was worded badly" from "Jev does not read how full the board is".

mostly_full.instructions: Standard chess rules apply. A rook moves along its column or rank, a bishop along its diagonals, a queen along either, and a knight jumps to a square two columns and one rank away or two ranks and one column away. Rook, bishop and queen lines are blocked by any piece in between. A pawn captures one square diagonally forward, white towards higher ranks and black towards lower ranks. Columns are numbered a=1 to h=8. A chess game starts with 32 pieces on the board and they come off as it goes on. More than 24 pieces are still on this board.

how_many.instructions: Standard chess rules apply. A rook moves along its column or rank, a bishop along its diagonals, a queen along either, and a knight jumps to a square two columns and one rank away or two ranks and one column away. Rook, bishop and queen lines are blocked by any piece in between. A pawn captures one square diagonally forward, white towards higher ranks and black towards lower ranks. Columns are numbered a=1 to h=8. How many pieces are still on this board?
criteria: Almost empty: about 8 pieces or fewer are left, the bare kings and a handful of others.
Half gone: somewhere around 16 pieces are left.
Almost untouched: nearly all 32 pieces are still there, very little has been captured.
